testimonials.name: Arjun Pradeep
testimonials.highlight_quote: During the process of activating the Maha Theerthas and the three Shiva Lingams, I could actually feel subtle sensations in my body... On the last day's meditation, I felt something really special during the Shiva Mandala and the merging process.
testimonials.full_testimonial:
The Beyond the Mind retreat was a really positive experience. Since this was my second time attending, it felt even more special doing it at Kanyakumari.

We started the first day with Pooja Veppu for ourselves, which was a great way to begin.

During the process of activating the Maha Theerthas and the three Shiva Lingams, I could actually feel subtle sensations in my body.

On the last day's meditation, even though there were many mandalas, I felt something really special during the Shiva Mandala and the merging process.

Learning about entity removal and getting to know about our spirit guides was very insightful. The soul liberation process was also a very good and experiential process.

Overall, it gave me a wonderful sense of calm and connection.

Thank you Pradeep Sir and a heartfelt thanks to all who were part of this retreat.

testimonials.name: Community Circle Reflection
testimonials.highlight_quote: Going from chaotic laughter to a quiet room is the hardest part... I'm already counting down the days until we gather again.
testimonials.full_testimonial: A reflection captured on the official BTM 2026 gathering poster, embodying the deep familial kinship, shared tears of release, and warm laughter that naturally blossoms when seekers come together under sincere guidance.

faqs.question: When and where does Beyond the Mind 2027 take place?
faqs.answer: Beyond the Mind 2027 takes place across four transformative days from Wednesday, October 6 to Saturday, October 9, 2027 in the sacred destination of Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India.

faqs.question: Do I need prior meditation or yoga experience to attend?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is necessary. Beyond the Mind welcomes sincere first-time seekers, experienced meditation practitioners, professionals, and international visitors alike. Every practice is introduced progressively with clear personal guidance by Pradeep Sir.

faqs.question: What language will the retreat sessions be conducted in?
faqs.answer: The retreat sessions are conducted primarily in English. Hindi translation assistance is readily available for participants who require it, ensuring complete clarity and depth for all attendees.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account or password to register?
faqs.answer: No. Participants do not need to register an account or set a password. Simply fill out the registration inquiry form with your contact details. Our team will review your application and personally reach out via WhatsApp and email with confirmation details.

faqs.question: How does the optional payment proof upload work?
faqs.answer: Once your application is reviewed and our team shares official retreat payment details, you may upload a screenshot of your bank transfer or UPI transaction reference. All uploaded screenshots are stored in a private, encrypted environment and marked as 'Pending Verification' until verified by our retreat administrator.

faqs.question: What is the Daily Guided Meditation program?
faqs.answer: In addition to the annual retreat, our team hosts regular online guided meditation sessions every Monday to Friday at 7:30 PM IST via Zoom. These are paid, interactive group sessions designed to anchor daily peace and discipline. You can inquire through our website or directly via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How do I reach Rishikesh for the retreat?
faqs.answer: Rishikesh is well connected. By air, fly into Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun, ~21 km). By train, arrive at Yog Nagari Rishikesh Railway Station or Haridwar Junction (~25 km). By road, deluxe coaches and private cabs connect easily from New Delhi (~240 km). Our concierge provides international and domestic travel assistance via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What are the accommodation and meal arrangements?
faqs.answer: We offer configurable options including private single rooms, twin-sharing options, and non-residential participation. Pure, sattvic, nourishing vegetarian meals are provided to support deep meditative practice. Specific dietary requirements can be indicated during registration.

faqs.question: Who is guiding the retreat?
faqs.answer: The retreat is guided by Pradeep Sir under the spiritual vision of Beyond the Mind and Moola Brahman. Guidance focuses on inner awakening, subtle energy channel balance, and compassionate personal transformation without sectarian dogma.
